# NTP

The behaviors that ntp calls, and each call that its examples make.
`osapi dsl chain get --name ntp` shows the same.

## Chain

|          |                                                                    |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Behavior | [ntp](../../behaviors/config/ntp/ntp.md)                           |

| Used by  | none                                                               |

| CALL                  | SENDS                                                                        | GETS                                                      |

| └─ managedfile update | content=&lt;2 lines&gt; path=/etc/chrony/sources.d/osapi-ntp.sources secret… | changed=true path=/etc/chrony/sources.d/osapi-ntp.sources |
